none: PAS FindID 958713: Roman coin: nummus of Constantine I VOX XX
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337) dating to the period c. AD 320-321 (Reece period 16). D N CONSTANTINI MAX AVG reverse type depicting laurel wreath enclosing inscription VOT/XX. Mint of Thessalonica. As RIC Vol VII, p.512, No. 117. Diameter: 18.79mm, Thickness: 2.02mm, Weight: 3.3g
